# bluestonepim_attribute_definition_context (Resource)

Sets the name and / or description of an attribute definition (of any type) for a specific context, for example another language or a sales channel. Values that are not set fall back to the fallback context.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "bluestonepim_context" "dutch" {
  name   = "Dutch"
  locale = "nl-NL"
}

resource "bluestonepim_attribute_definition" "ean" {
  name        = "EAN"
  description = "European Article Number"
  data_type   = "text"
}

resource "bluestonepim_attribute_definition_context" "ean_nl" {
  definition_id = bluestonepim_attribute_definition.ean.id
  context_id    = bluestonepim_context.dutch.id
  name          = "EAN-code"
  description   = "Europees artikelnummer"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `context_id` (String) The ID of the context (see `bluestonepim_context`).
- `definition_id` (String) The ID of the attribute definition.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the attribute definition in this context.
- `name` (String) The name of the attribute definition in this context.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import bluestonepim_attribute_definition_context.ean_nl <definition_id>/<context_id>
```
